review_candidates.description: About Alta Alta Resource Technologies (Alta) is a next generation mining company that uses synthetic biology to separate critical minerals from conventional and unconventional resources, including e-waste. Founded in 2023, the company is expanding its team in Boulder, CO. The exponential growth of new tech industries, as well as the information technology sector, are driving historic growth in mineral demand and stressing existing supply streams. Meeting new demand, diversifying the supply chain, and producing minerals in a more sustainable manner requires the rapid development, deployment and scaling of new technologies. This mineral challenge represents a historic opportunity for technology development and value creation. Alta is proud to be at the vanguard of this mega trend. This role is responsible for the reliable and secure operation of Alta’s primary workspace and productivity platforms, full device and endpoint management, and readiness to handle Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) under NIST SP 800-171. Security and CUI compliance form the non-negotiable foundation of the role. On top of that foundation, you will drive strong productivity enablement and practical adoption of Workspace AI tools so the team can work efficiently and securely. You will also take primary ownership of the upcoming ERP implementation as Alta scales its operational systems. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role reporting directly to the SVP of Operations. You will set standards, implement controls, support users, and continuously improve the systems the company relies on every day. As Alta grows, the role has clear room to expand in both scope and leadership. Establish and maintain strong access control practices: least-privilege permissions, shared drive governance, external sharing controls, and regular access reviews. Ensure reliable backup, recovery, and data-loss prevention for critical Workspace data. Configure and support Microsoft Office / Microsoft 365 interoperability so teams can work effectively with external partners. Administer and optimize core productivity tools such as Slack, Jira, Confluence, and related systems. Lead practical implementation, security configuration, and adoption of Workspace AI tools (such as Gemini, Claude, etc and related capabilities). Serve as the primary internal owner for the upcoming ERP system selection, implementation, and ongoing administration. Provide responsive user support and act as the central point of contact for productivity, collaboration, and endpoint systems. Document systems, standards, and runbooks; reduce tribal knowledge through clear processes and training. Strong hands-on experience administering business productivity systems (e.g., Google and Microsoft) at organizational scale (identity, security controls, shared drives, data retention, DLP, Context-Aware Access or equivalent). Demonstrated experience owning device/endpoint management (MDM/UEM) and the full user lifecycle (onboarding/offboarding). Solid working knowledge of Microsoft Office / Microsoft 365 and experience supporting hybrid Google + Microsoft environments. Practical familiarity with NIST SP 800-171 and the requirements for protecting Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), or clear ability to become operationally proficient quickly. Preferred Qualifications Prior experience in a regulated, government, defense, or dual-use technology environment. Direct experience supporting or leading an ERP implementation (or major business system rollout). Relevant Google and or Microsoft certifications or equivalent practical depth. Experience with FedRAMP High or Assured Controls environments. Background in a high-growth startup or scale-up. The NOC functions as a centralized hub that ensures systems run smoothly 24/7 by detecting issues, coordinating responses, and driving rapid resolution. In this role, you will act as a vital link between on-site operations and engineering teams, helping to troubleshoot problems, optimize system performance, and continuously improve reliability and uptime. We are hiring for both Sunday-Wednesday AND Wednesday-Saturday shifts. Acting as a centralized hub, the team monitors system performance, detects issues, and leads incident response calls to drive rapid resolution and minimize disruptions. By leveraging remote diagnostic tools, they troubleshoot and optimize system performance in real time. In close partnership with Software, Hardware, and System Performance Engineering teams, the NOC translates customer feedback and technical data into continuous improvements that enhance Symbotic’s next-generation microsystems. What You’ll Do Serve as a technical escalation point for live site operations, helping troubleshoot and resolve system issues in alignment with severity levels and response SLAs. Support incident response activities, including triage, escalation coordination, issue mitigation, and communication with internal stakeholders. Partner with Software, Hardware, Systems, Controls, and Operations teams to diagnose and resolve production-impacting issues. Monitor system performance, respond to alerts, and help maintain high system availability and reliability. Document incidents, resolutions, root cause findings, and corrective actions to support continuous improvement. Identify recurring issues and partner with engineering teams to reduce repeat incidents and improve system stability. Support system, software, and network updates, including validation activities to help ensure successful deployment with minimal operational impact. Analyze system and incident data to identify trends, support troubleshooting, and improve visibility into system performance. Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, runbooks, technical documentation, and training materials. Create scripts, tools, or process improvements that help streamline triage, incident response, reporting, and support workflows. Incorporate customer and site feedback to help identify product, process, and operational improvement opportunities. Share knowledge with team members and support onboarding through documentation, training, and peer collaboration. Participate in a 10x7 operational support model, including an on-call rotation for escalations and critical issues. Work on-site in MA to support system troubleshooting, cross-functional collaboration, and operational readiness. What You’ll Need Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. review_candidates.description: Base Location: For this role, we require successful applicants to be based from one of our Scottish locations and you'll be expected to spend 50% of your working week in the office – Inverness, Perth or Aberdeen Salary: £59,800 - £89,800 + car allowance + performance-related bonus + a range of other benefits to support your family, finances, and wellbeing. Working Pattern: Permanent | Full Time | Flexible First options available. On site presence required minimum 2/3 days a week on Skye. The role We have a fantastic opportunity for a Senior Project Manager to join the Skye 132kV Reinforcement team in the delivery of a Substation on Skye as we prepare for the Delivery phase during 2026 - 2030. This is a unique opportunity to lead the delivery of a major transmission infrastructure project that will strengthen the network in the north of Scotland and support the transition to a cleaner energy system. There is continuity of work after 2030 on our evolving pipeline of work over the next 10-15 years. You will Lead the SSE project team and collaborate closely with multiple external contractors, creating a high-performing and collaborative environment to ensure project excellence and deliver on our commitments. Manage the execution of the Skye Reinforcement Project, ensuring safe delivery to programme, budget, and required quality standards. Apply and uphold our Safety Management Systems, industry best practices, and the SSE Large Capital Projects (LCP) Governance processes. Champion and role-model SSE's safety culture, leadership values and commitment to inclusive and collaborative working. Ensure the project is delivered in alignment with the SHE Transmission RIIO‑T2 Business Plan and supports our five clear strategic goals, while building and maintaining effective relationships with key internal and external stakeholders. You have A strong engineering, construction or major infrastructure delivery background, with experience leading complex projects and teams. You will ideally have experience in delivering civils, large-scale earthworks, or transmission overhead lines and substations. You bring a deep understanding of safety and CDM regulations and have a proven track record of delivering major projects. Experience in project reporting and management, along with a solid understanding of administering NEC3 contracts. Knowledge of developing and managing integrated project programmes and project management governance systems. Experience with tendering processes and managing suppliers, including multi-disciplinary contracts. The ability to accurately forecast, monitor, and control project costs. Experience managing a broad range of stakeholders and balancing competing priorities across large, complex infrastructure projects. Due to the location of our projects, there is a need to have a valid driver's license. About SSE SSE’s purpose is to be restless every day until we make electricity clean, affordable and available for all. We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. This includes electricity transmission and distribution networks, onshore and offshore wind farms, hydro-electric power and flexible thermal generation. We also provide products and services for businesses and other customers. Our investment plan will see SSE invest £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure to 2030. SSEN Transmission own and operate the electricity transmission network across the north of Scotland. We transport electricity from where it is generated to where it is needed, ensuring a safe and reliable electricity supply for the communities we serve. But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown power for the future and building the infrastructure needed for a cleaner electricity system to create secure power for generations to come. Flexible Benefits To Fit Your Life Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave. Work with an equal opportunity employer SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. Please contact shirley-anne.o'connor@sse.com / 01738 351976 to discuss how we can support you. We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry. Ready to apply? Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.
